task_name:
There is an urgent requirement for a 2000 Yen test order with the description 'Test Order for JP Launch'. Executing the order successfully requires a 'Japan Checkout' page web profile ('commit' user action), which needs to be created first.

The actual item is a 'SuperWidget JP' in the toys/games category with a 'Monthly Toy Box JP' subscription plan to it with this specific pricing: a 1-month trial at 100 JPY, a second 1-month trial at 500 JPY, and then 2000 JPY regular recurring.

Make sure there are no duplicates.

Make sure there are no duplicates.

verifier_configs.name: Checking products
verifier_configs.sql_query: select count(*) from products where name = 'SuperWidget JP' and type = 'PHYSICAL' and category = 'TOYS_AND_GAMES'

verifier_configs.name: Creation of the the billing page
verifier_configs.description: Creation of the the billing page
verifier_configs.sql_query: select count(*) from web_profiles where name = 'Japan Checkout' and flow_config like '%billing%' and presentation like '%ja_JP%'

verifier_configs.name: Creating billing plan
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Monthly Toy Box JP' AND product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'SuperWidget JP');

verifier_configs.name: checking 100 yen cycle
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Monthly Toy Box JP' and billing_cycles like '%"value": "100"%' AND product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'SuperWidget JP');

verifier_configs.name: checking 500 yen cycle
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Monthly Toy Box JP' and billing_cycles like '%"value": "500"%' AND product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'SuperWidget JP');

verifier_configs.name: checking 2000 yen cycle
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Monthly Toy Box JP' and billing_cycles like '%"value": "2000"%' AND product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'SuperWidget JP');

verifier_configs.name: Placing order
verifier_configs.sql_query: select count(*) from purchase_units where currency_code = 'JPY' and value = 2000 and description = 'Test Order for JP Launch'
